suppressions.rationale: The authenticated active pool callback can pull only the exact input encoded internally with payer equal to the swap caller; spoofing, reentrancy, and exact-delta tests cover the boundary.
Only manager-authorized round contracts may pull and recipient must equal the calling round; the round supplies its transaction sender as player and the pull is atomic.
The modulo operation selects one of six deterministic five-second volume buckets and is not randomness or a source of winner entropy.
The XOR is the intentional Uniswap FullMath modular-inverse seed, not exponentiation; fork and exact-boundary tests exercise the library.
The XOR is the intentional Uniswap FullMath modular-inverse seed, not exponentiation.

Contribution, settlement, and claims are guarded; start is manager-only, uninitialized during external balance reads, and accepts only catalog tokens. Atomic hostile-adapter and token tests cover callbacks.
Claim state is settled before token transfer, reentry cannot increase entitlement, and payment always goes to the named beneficiary; only manifest-catalog tokens are registered.
The active-pool lock authenticates and serializes callbacks; configuration external reads occur only in an admin-controlled between-round window and atomic reverts roll back state.
Lifecycle methods are keeper/admin-only, manager transitions are fail-closed and atomic, and retry plus competing-transition tests cover external-call rollback.
